profile: Shattuck Labs is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing monoclonal and bispecific antibodies that block the DR3 receptor for inflammatory and immune-mediated diseases. Its lead candidate, SL-325, is a DR3-blocking monoclonal antibody being evaluated in a Phase 1 clinical trial. The company’s research and development work focuses on therapies targeting the DR3/TL1A pathway, including potential treatments for inflammatory bowel disease.
